narrator.instruct: Gripping, energetic storyteller telling a comic disaster with a twist, brisk and excited, never calm.

mp.instruct: Pompous Victorian gentleman politician, loud, triumphant and very pleased with himself.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He just dumped a hundred tons of lime into the Thames.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the river is about to send it back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: London, eighteen fifty-eight. Thirty degrees, and the heat won't break.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: London's sewers empty into the river, right under Parliament's windows.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Members flee their own library.

lines.speaker: mp
lines.text: Lime! Pour it into every sewer mouth!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Barges tip lime at the sewer mouths, and the brown water slides away.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He throws open the window and breathes in.

lines.speaker: mp
lines.text: Gone! Good riddance, filthy river!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He flings his stinking hat after it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the tide turns.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The river runs backward, and his hat floats right back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: With everything else. The committee runs for the door.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here's the catch. At Westminster, the Thames is tidal.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sea pushes in, then drags out, over and over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Whatever you pour in sloshes up and down under your nose. Lime can't fix that.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So engineer Joseph Bazalgette catches the sewage before the river.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Eighty-two miles of sewers carry it east, past the city.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Into a reservoir holding twenty-seven million gallons.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The gates open at high tide, and the ebb drags it out to sea.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Parliament passed the law in just eighteen days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the hat? It's still riding the tide.
